إبراهيم بن محمد بن مالك بن زيد

notes: «وعن إبراهيم بن محمد» opens with a bare «وعن»: it refers back to the previous report's chain. The names before him are not written in this text, and the nearest written chain (prev2) does not name him, so no inherited names are written. Needs a check against the previous report.
«كنت مع أبي عند رسول الله» : the father is in the scene for saying 1; in saying 2 Jabir asks him («فسألت أبي») so he is a link (rule 5).
«ثم أخفى صوته» is the narrator's gloss on the Prophet's speech, left out.
